entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh right, today's Valentine's Day.[n]No wonder there were so many guys[n]bringing girls in here.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you have anything exciting[n]happening? I mean, you've been here[n]nearly a whole year.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, when I was young, hoo boy...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ohhh... You should've just told me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here, I'll leave the store to you.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Oh, no... It's not like I'm trying to[n]lecture you...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: The reason I'm here today is...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Through my attempt to make that...[n]I realized... my lack of talent.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: All I did was melt whatever I bought at[n]the market, so it should be fine... I think.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Until I met you, I never imagined that[n]I'd have... a boyfriend.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I need to devote myself to learning how[n]to do things... other than shogi.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Next year... please let me atone for my...[n]homemade chocolates.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I no longer participate in that nonsense.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: The pre-shoot dietary restrictions were[n]simply... grueling.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: People still call me the Phony Princess.[n]I'm quite the villain now.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: But to be honest, I like it better than[n]being treated like an idol. It's really[n]freeing.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: As long as I have a board and playing[n]pieces... I can go anywhere with shogi...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: So my goal is to be the best professional[n]shogi player wherever I may be...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Do you understand what I'm[n]trying to say?
I should tell Hifumi that I'm[n]going home...
I'll be returning to my hometown.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I would like to sit next to you.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I never felt distressed being alone, until[n]I met you...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: You're going home next month, yes?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It isn't something you have to apologize[n]about...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I apologize for discussing such a heavy[n]topic when we haven't seen each other[n]for so long...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Well, I was able to wait for you until[n]you were discharged, so living apart[n]won't be difficult...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I can't seem to conceal my true[n]emotions... from you.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...That means I'm quite serious about[n]you... and I will not allow a redo...
I spent a romantic evening[n]with Hifumi...
